description: Object to the application of a passed proposal during its timelock window. Writes an objector-signed net.openfederation.governance.objection record into the objector's own repo. The change is held once governanceConfig.objectionThreshold countable objections exist; that threshold defaults to 1, so a single member holding community.governance.write can hold a passed proposal. Eligibility is the same community.governance.write permission that gates voting. A hold opens one override round (status 'objection-override'): the electorate votes again against overrideQuorum, by default two-thirds of the electorate and never below quorum + 1, inside governanceConfig.objectionOverrideDays. Reaching it applies the change immediately; the round expiring short of it rejects the proposal, so the objection stands. An objection therefore raises the bar a decision must clear rather than replacing it, and cannot be repeated — a proposal already in its override round is answered by voting in that round. A community that wants a hold to be final sets governanceConfig.objectionReview to 'none', which restores the permanent 'objected' state.

reason.description: Rationale published with the objection record.

status.description: Proposal status after the objection: 'objection-override' when the threshold was reached and the hold opened an override round, 'objected' when it was reached in a community with objectionReview 'none', otherwise unchanged ('pending-application') because the threshold has not been reached.

objectionCount.description: Countable objections standing against this decision, including this one.

objectionThreshold.description: Countable objections required to hold the change (governanceConfig.objectionThreshold; defaults to 1).

objection.description: The objector-signed record, readable through com.atproto.repo.getRecord.

overrideQuorum.description: Votes FOR the override round this objection opened must reach. Present only when the objection opened a round.

overrideExpiresAt.description: When the override round this objection opened stops accepting votes. Present only when the objection opened a round.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing fields, or reason longer than 2000 characters.

errors.name: ProposalNotPending
errors.description: The proposal is not awaiting application, so there is no window to object into.

errors.name: ObjectionWindowClosed
errors.description: The contest window has closed, or the proposal is already held — including while it is in its override round, which is answered by voting rather than by objecting again.

errors.name: AlreadyObjected
errors.description: You have already objected to this proposal.

errors.name: NotMember
errors.description: Caller is not a member of this community.

errors.name: ObjectionNotRecordable
errors.description: The objector has no repository, so the objection cannot be written as an objector-signed record and is refused rather than held on unverifiable evidence.
